name: web-translator
description: Translate one public static HTML page or one local or public text-selectable PDF into reviewed Korean output.

interface.shortDescription: Translate public HTML or local/public PDFs into reviewed Korean output.
interface.longDescription: Provides separate workflows for a public static HTML page and a local or public text-selectable PDF while sharing contextual translation and master-review contracts.
defaultPrompt: Translate this public HTML page into an offline Korean bundle, or translate this local or public text-selectable PDF into a reviewed Korean PDF.
